I will buy two bags of NPK 20-10-10 from the agro-dealer because the government makes it affordable and our soil here in the North Central is tired and needs help to produce good maize. I will also spread cow manure from our animals before planting, and I will use our own saved seed as I have always done. We will do the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, but I will hire two or three young men from the village for about five days when the weeding and harvesting are heavy. I do not spray chemicals on maize because it is costly and we do not have those pests here like they do on cowpea, and the rains from April to October are enough so I will not irrigate.
